title: Add adaptive span prioritizer and cost-shadow mirroring
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: Production observability is overwhelmed by full-span captures for low-value invocations which inflate storage and increase query latency. This PR introduces two cooperating subsystems: (1) an adaptive span prioritizer that scores and marks spans for deep collection based on cost, error-signals, and session importance; (2) a low-priority 'cost-shadow' mirroring sink that asynchronously mirrors token-level cost and phase metrics to a cold store for long-tail analysis without touching the hot metrics pipeline. Goals: reduce full-trace ingestion volume by targeting high-signal invocations, preserve ability to analyze rare expensive cases via mirrored shadow data, avoid any change to customer-facing metrics semantics. What changed: added prioritizer service with policy rules, sampling heuristics and pluggable scoring; introduced a new telemetry sink that mirrors a compact cost-only envelope to S3/Cold ES; added routing and safe-fallback so if the prioritizer is down we default to legacy sampling; added end-to-end integration tests and dashboard updates. Checklist: [x] prioritizer core logic implemented; [x] cost-shadow sink + backpressure handling; [x] feature flag gate (observability.prioritizer.enabled=false by default); [x] docs and runbook; [x] infra helm values for toggling mirror retention; [x] e2e tests and load test validation. Rollout plan: feature gated rollout to internal canary tenants for 2 weeks, monitor SLOs and ingestion-queue lag, then enable for low-volume customers and increase. Linear: ENG-9231 implements prioritizer rules; ENG-13104 wires mirror sink and storage lifecycle. Related work: builds on prior token-cost-attribution infra (see ENG-7425) and complements the prefetched-kv warmup traces work. Risks and mitigations: risk of losing rare-context detail if prioritizer mis-scores; mitigation includes conservative defaults, a short-term default TTL on mirrors and a manual override to force-capture by trace ID. Backwards compatibility: hot metrics stream and existing dashboards unchanged unless mirror flag enabled. Performance: local microbench and canary load tests show ~35% reduction in full-span ingest and <3% CPU overhead on proxy path while mirroring adds negligible tail-latency due to async buffering. Merge notes: squash-merged after addressing final review comments and flaky test re-run.
commits: feat(observability): adaptive span prioritizer service; feat(telemetry): add cost-shadow mirroring sink and compact envelope; perf: buffer/backpressure improvements; test: add unit and integration tests; docs: observability runbook and dashboard additions
review_comments: Liam: asked for clearer failure-mode semantics and a short-circuit when the mirror sink falls behind; Noah: requested additional unit tests for policy edge-cases and tighter typing on sink envelopes; Marisol: asked to add a runbook section for an operator to force-capture a trace ID and to confirm retention requirements for mirrors. Author replies: clarified backpressure behavior and added an emergency capture API; added requested tests and typed encoder; documented retention defaults. CI: initial lint found style nits, one flaky integration test 'test_cost_shadow_integration' failed on first run due to race on bucket teardown — retried and passed. Approvals: reviewers approved after fixes. Merge: squash merge into main with feature flag off by default.
release_notes: Introduce adaptive span prioritizer (feature-flagged) to reduce full-trace ingestion and a cost-shadow mirroring sink for long-tail token-cost analysis. Default off; operators can enable per-tenant. Includes runbook and dashboards.
notes_for_ops: Enable via helm: observability.prioritizer.enabled=true and configure cost-shadow.s3.bucket and retention. Monitor priorizer-queue-lag and cost-shadow-backpressure alerts. Emergency trace-capture endpoint: POST /internal/observability/force-capture {trace_id}.
